shoot.lore: Patient hands, steady breath. A trooper learns that one clean shot saves more lives than ten loud ones.

strike.lore: The blade moves before the thought finishes. Every Padawan is taught that the strike is the last answer, not the first.

guard.lore: To stand between a blow and a friend is the oldest Jedi lesson. The Guardian does not ask who deserves it.

overwatch.lore: Waiting is a kind of fighting. The soldier who holds still and watches the door decides who walks through it.

push.lore: A breath of the Force, shaped into a shove. It carries no malice, only a firm request to be elsewhere.

collapse.lore: The Force gathers, then falls on one place at once. Masters warn that power taken this wide leaves a mark on the one who takes it.

choke.lore: The Council forbids it. A hand closes on a throat from across the room, and the one who holds it feels the dark answer back.

stun.lore: A pulse that quiets the body without breaking it. Mercy is a discipline, and it is harder than the alternative.

subdue.lore: The Jedi prefer a prisoner who can talk to a corpse who cannot. Many a captive has surprised them with what they knew.

meditate.lore: Stillness is not rest. The Jedi sits inside the storm and listens for what the Force is trying to say.

heal.lore: The Force knits what the blade has opened. It does not take away the fear, and the Jedi never claims that it does.

grenade.lore: A small sphere, a short fuse, a loud decision. Troopers throw them at cover, and cover rarely argues.

stabilize.lore: A field medic’s first rule: keep them here. Everything else can be solved once the bleeding stops.

door.lore: Every door in the Temple was built to open to a hand that is welcome. Out in the field, doors are less polite.

console.lore: Old machines hold new secrets. A steady hand and a patient tech can still coax the truth out of them.

scan.lore: The Force reaches out and returns with shapes, heartbeats, and the cold spots where something is hiding.

plant.lore: Set the charge, count the steps, leave. Sabotage is quiet work done by people who would rather not be thanked.

saberThrow.lore: A lightsaber thrown is a lightsaber risked. The Force brings it back, but the Jedi learns the length of a moment without it.

defLine.lore: The blade turns the bolt. Another Jedi stands at the shoulder, and together they make a wall no blaster wants to test.

leap.lore: A Jedi’s jump is not strength but trust. The Force holds the air for the length of a heartbeat, and that is enough.

reflectM.lore: The Force shows the bolt before it leaves the barrel. The blade is only there to finish the thought.

sweep.lore: One wide arc, and the room is a different place. The Guardian’s answer to being surrounded is to become the center.

forceHeal.lore: The deeper art. A Consular gives of their own strength to restore another’s, and rests afterward without complaint.

barrier.lore: A shell of will, thin as breath and hard as durasteel while it holds. Consulars say it is easier to build for others than for oneself.

battleMed.lore: Bacta, a steady voice, and a Force touch when the bacta runs short. The Temple’s healers learned to work under fire.

mindTrick.lore: A suggestion, offered so gently that the listener believes it was their own idea. The Consulars say it is not a trick but a courtesy.

forceRevive.lore: The Force can call back a life that has barely left. It asks a great deal, and the Jedi who answers is never quite the same.

suppress.lore: Fire that does not seek to hit, only to keep heads down. A soldier’s way of buying others a few seconds of safe ground.

hunker.lore: Get low, get small, let the world pass over. Surviving a bad moment is also a victory.

mark.lore: A spotter calls the target and everyone’s aim improves. Calm voices win more battles than brave ones.

smoke.lore: A cloud to move behind. The enemy fires at where you were, and you are somewhere else.

hack.lore: Slicers say every lock is a conversation. Patience and a little cleverness will make most systems say yes.

shredder.lore: Armor is a promise that a shot will not matter. The shredder round exists to break that promise.

rapidFire.lore: All the weapon’s patience spent at once. The heavy trooper trades accuracy for the certainty that something will land.

deadeye.lore: One shot, taken after the long wait. A scout learns to hold their breath until the world holds still with them.

rally.lore: A word at the right moment. Veterans know that courage is mostly borrowed, passed hand to hand along the line.

reviveStim.lore: A sharp sting and a gasp. Medics carry the stim for the worst day, and hope never to need it.

rocket.lore: It is loud, and it is meant to be. The heavy trooper fires one when quiet has already failed.

flurry.lore: The Form takes over. Cut follows cut so quickly that the opponent has no time to be afraid of the next one.

shadowStep.lore: A Sentinel moves where eyes do not rest. They are there, and then they are behind you.

executioner.lore: Some blows end a fight before it begins. Jedi who learn this also learn how heavy it is to use.

sense.lore: The Force whispers before the danger arrives. Sentinels trust that whisper and have been alive longer for it.

disarm.lore: A flick of the wrist and the weapon is somewhere else. The Jedi way is to end the fight without ending the foe.

pathfinder.lore: Where others see rubble, a scout sees a road. The best ones leave no tracks for anyone to follow.

beastCalm.lore: Even a hungry thing can be soothed by a patient mind. It is slow work, and a gentle one.

pull.lore: The Force draws what you need into your hand, or an enemy into your reach. Take care, because it works both directions.

tremor.lore: The ground itself remembers the Jedi’s step. A tremor rolls outward and knocks the unready off their feet.

wildBond.lore: Some Jedi feel the creatures of the wild more clearly than they feel people. The bond is quiet, and it is real.

runGun.lore: A good soldier fires while moving, and a great one forgets the difference. Practice, bruises, and more practice.

spotter.lore: A second pair of eyes behind the first. The shot is the shooter’s, but the war is won by the one who sees the whole field.

ghost.lore: Gone before the alarm sounds. A scout who is never noticed is a scout whose reports always arrive.

protocol.lore: Orders, drilled until they are habit. In the dark and the noise, protocol is what remains when thinking is too slow.

shieldDrone.lore: A small hovering disc that does one thing well. Soldiers name them anyway, and are not embarrassed to.

ionNade.lore: It does not harm flesh, only wires. Machines go quiet and the battle changes shape.

holdLine.lore: Not one step back. The line holds because each person on it decides, separately, that it will.

flakVest.lore: Layered plating, scuffed and patched. Every trooper has a story about the bolt it stopped.

veteran.lore: Experience is a kind of armor. The veteran has seen this before, and the calm they carry spreads along the line.

longshot.lore: Distance is only a matter of patience. The long barrel, the steady breath, the shot that nobody heard coming.

killshot.lore: A trained eye finds the gap in the armor. It is not cruelty, only competence at a hard trade.

fieldcraft.lore: Cover, concealment, silence. The things that are not in the manual but have kept every old scout alive.

fieldKit.lore: Bandages, a stim, and one clean cloth. Small things that matter most when everything else has gone wrong.

combatMedic.lore: The medic fights because the line breaks without them. Carrying a rifle and a kit takes a particular kind of courage.

traumaBag.lore: Heavy and worn, it never leaves the medic’s shoulder. What is inside has stopped more wounds than any speech.

bandolier.lore: Spare cells across the chest, clipped and counted. A soldier who runs dry is a soldier who is no longer useful to the people next to them.

juggernaut.lore: The heavy trooper walks into the fire because the others cannot. Armor, mass, and the stubbornness to keep walking.

mightyBlow.lore: All the weight of the Form behind one stroke. Guardians are taught that restraint is what makes such a blow safe to swing.

precisionStrike.lore: Not the hardest cut but the truest. The blade goes exactly where the Force showed it would be needed.

massHeal.lore: The Force spreads outward like warmth through a cold room. Every hurt in reach eases, and the Consular asks nothing in return.

forceWave.lore: A ring of pressure rolls out from the Jedi’s hands. Nothing in its path is spared, and nothing in its path is meant to be killed.

stasisField.lore: The air thickens, then stops. Those caught in it find their limbs unwilling, and the Consular holds the pause with great effort.

chainShot.lore: The first shot is a question and the second is the answer. A good gunner learns to ask twice before the target can react.

medBeacon.lore: A single bright signal and the wounded know where to crawl. The medic can give it only once, and gives it fully.

gIron.lore: Years of drills in the Salle have taught the body to take a blow and keep standing. The Guardian counts bruises as lessons.

gDuelist.lore: A Guardian who studies a rival’s feet more than their blade. The duel is often won before the first stroke.

gBulwark.lore: On guard, the Jedi becomes a fixed point. Allies know exactly where the line is and trust that it will not move.

gVanguard.lore: The first through every door. A Vanguard takes the risk so that those behind can measure it.

gWarden.lore: The Warden’s blade seems to be wherever the bolt is going. Those who watch it work call it luck, and the Warden calls it attention.

gUnbreakable.lore: Some Guardians simply refuse to fall. It is not stubbornness, they say, but a promise made to everyone standing behind them.

gMasterBlade.lore: The sum of a lifetime of patient practice. The blade is no longer a tool but a part of the hand.

cSerene.lore: A mind that has learned to be quiet. The Force flows more freely through a Jedi who is not arguing with themselves.

cResolve.lore: Fear is acknowledged, then set down. The Consular who has done this once finds it easier to do again.

cWellspring.lore: A deep calm that seems to refill itself. Consulars say the Force is not spent so much as borrowed and returned.

cSeer.lore: The battle slows to those who have learned to read it. The Consular steps where the next moment will be, not where the last one was.

cMaster.lore: A Consular who has stopped fearing the Force and started listening to it. Such Jedi are rare, and rarely proud of it.

sKeenEye.lore: A Sentinel notices the loose stone, the shifted shadow, the breath held too long. Most of survival is simply noticing.

sExecutioner.lore: A Sentinel who has learned exactly where a fight turns. The finishing stroke is quick, and no one is allowed to enjoy it.

sTracker.lore: Footprints, scorch marks, the stillness of a room just emptied. The Tracker follows the story the enemy leaves behind.

sVigil.lore: The Sentinel who keeps watch through the dark hours. Nothing reaches the camp that has not first reached them.

sEdge.lore: A blade kept honest by daily care. The Sentinel treats sharpening as a kind of meditation.

sGhost.lore: The Sentinel crosses open ground as if the ground were reluctant to notice. Lessons in stealth are never entirely spoken.

sHunter.lore: Patient and unhurried, the Hunter lets the quarry make the first mistake. It always does.

sBlademaster.lore: The Forms are no longer steps to be remembered. The Sentinel lives inside them and the blade simply follows.

sUntouchable.lore: Bolts and blades pass through spaces the Jedi has already left. It looks like grace, and it is years of discipline.

wPathfinder.lore: Where the map ends, the Wayseeker keeps walking. A path appears for anyone who truly expects one.

wWild.lore: The Force in living things, felt in the roots as clearly as in the stars. The Wayseeker draws on a deeper spring.

wRoots.lore: A body trained by long travel and little comfort. The Wayseeker endures what would send others home.

wStalker.lore: Someone who learned to move through wild places learned to move quietly. The skill carries over to every other kind of ground.

wBond.lore: The creatures of the wild trust the Wayseeker, and the Wayseeker returns the trust. Neither side has ever been disappointed.

wSeer.lore: Distance is no barrier for those who listen. The Wayseeker sees the far ridge as clearly as the near.

wPrimal.lore: Old instincts woken beneath careful training. The Wayseeker is a little frightening to watch, and knows it.

soGunner.lore: Hours at the range and nights cleaning the barrel. Good shooting is mostly habit and a little stubbornness.

soTough.lore: A trooper who has been knocked down enough times to know how to get up. The lesson is physical, and also not.

soMarksman.lore: The kind of shooter who is quiet at the range because the targets have said all there is to say.

soSteel.lore: Fear is a visitor, and the veteran does not offer it a chair. The line holds because the people on it are calm.

soIronWill.lore: Orders, duty, and a stubborn refusal to be turned. Few things are as hard to move as a soldier who has decided.

soCommander.lore: A trooper whose voice carries and whose plans work. Others fall in without being asked, and are glad to.

soLegend.lore: Stories are told about this one in barracks across the Republic. The trooper rolls their eyes and keeps shooting.

scEagle.lore: A scout whose sight is a gift and a discipline. Distant things become plain, and plain things become useful.

scQuick.lore: Light on the feet and quick to the next cover. A scout lives in the spaces between where the enemy is looking.

scSniper.lore: One breath held, one shot let go. The Sniper is a rumor that sometimes becomes a fact.

scAssassin.lore: Cold work for a necessary end. The scout who does it well rarely speaks of it afterward.

scSurvivor.lore: Others would have been left behind long ago. The Survivor has learned that coming home is a skill like any other.

scSpotter.lore: The scout calls the range, the wind, and the target in one calm sentence. Every rifle nearby gets a little better.

scDeadly.lore: Familiar with every gap in every armor design. The scout is not cruel, only precise.

scLegend.lore: A name whispered on the Rim and rarely seen on a report. The scout prefers it that way.

scPhantom.lore: Across rubble and open street without a sound. By the time the enemy turns, the Phantom is elsewhere.

mDrilled.lore: Field medicine learned by the book, then by the bruise. The drills make the hands steady when the voice is not.

mSurgeon.lore: Clean cuts and clean thinking on the worst night. A good surgeon is calm because someone else cannot be.

mStoic.lore: The medic has seen the worst a battlefield can offer. They keep working, and the squad draws strength from it.

mFieldSurgeon.lore: Full kits, sorted by urgency, ready in the dark. The medic can find what they need by touch.

mMarksman.lore: A medic who learned that sometimes the best treatment is keeping the enemy from firing. Few argue with the logic.

mAngel.lore: Soldiers on three worlds swear to have been saved by this one. The medic shrugs and moves on to the next.

mVeteran.lore: Years in the field have taught this medic where to stand and when to run. Survivors remember the lessons gladly.

hDemo.lore: A heavy trooper with a respect for chemistry. Everything that explodes is eventually a tool.

hBrute.lore: Built to carry, built to endure. The heavy trooper does the work nobody else wants and does not complain.

hBulwark.lore: A slow and steady wall of armor and nerve. Allies shelter behind it, and it does not flinch.

hGunner.lore: Heavy weapons need a steady hand and a patient eye. The gunner has both, which is rarer than it sounds.

hHeavyWeapons.lore: Years of training with weapons that others cannot lift. The recoil is a conversation the gunner has learned to win.

hTitan.lore: A figure out of old stories, mountainous in plate. The trooper walks through fire and the enemy remembers it.

hWarlord.lore: A heavy trooper who has stopped waiting for orders. On this ground, the Warlord is the order.

trooper.lore: Sith Empire infantry, trained hard and ordered harder. Most of them believe in the Empire because they have never been offered another future.

heavy.lore: A walking wall in Imperial plate, with a gun that wants to be heard. It is slow to turn and quick to punish those who stand still.

agent.lore: Imperial Intelligence does not announce itself. A cold hide, a long rifle, and a patience the Temple’s own scouts would respect.

acolyte.lore: A student of the Sith, hungry to be noticed by someone with more power. Lightning crackles in the fingers, and mercy has not yet been taught.

husk.lore: What is left when a great horror feeds. A Dark Husk has no mind of its own, only hunger, and it moves when its maker kills.

terentatek.lore: A beast bred, it is said, to hunt those who touch the Force. The Jedi who survive an encounter rarely describe it, but the nightmares do.

envoy.lore: A Republic envoy with the right smile and the wrong friends. Whispers say that someone close to the talks is selling the schedule.

malgus.lore: A Sith Lord who believes the Republic is a lie and means to prove it with fire. He fights like a man with nothing left to lose.

mando.lore: Mandalorian clans, hired by the Empire for the oldest reason there is. They fight with honor and are paid in credits.

adraas.lore: Lord Adraas fought beside Malgus in the strike on Coruscant. Those who faced him remember how little he seemed to care about the cost.

bh_trooper.lore: Foot soldiers of the Brotherhood of Darkness, devoted to Lord Kaan’s vision. They fight as though the war were already won, and that certainty is their weapon.

bh_marauder.lore: A Dark Side warrior who fights for rage as much as for Kaan. The wounds only seem to feed it.

sith_lord.lore: One of the Brotherhood’s Lords, who sees the Light as a delay to be removed. The troopers around it fight as if its approval were air.

bh_sniper.lore: A hired gun on the ridge who is paid to be patient. The Brotherhood buys loyalty with ideals and loyalty from this one with credits.

sith_spawn.lore: A creature born of the dark side in the Ruusan caves, hungry only for the Force. Soldiers without the gift pass it unnoticed, and it cannot forgive that.

nexus.lore: A wound in the world where the dark side pools and festers. It does not move or speak, but it makes more of itself.

nexus_core.lore: The heart of the cave, where the dark gathers. It beats slowly, and anyone who stays near it begins to hear it.

kaan.lore: Lord Kaan, leader of the Brotherhood of Darkness, sure that the Sith should lead the galaxy. He is brilliant, ruthless, and wrong in a way he will never accept.

bane.lore: Darth Bane, a Sith apprentice who watches from the ridge and listens to the war with a stranger’s attention. He survives Ruusan, and what he builds from it will outlast everyone here.

Standard blaster.lore: A standard-issue Republic blaster, worn smooth by many hands. It is not elegant, but it fires every time.

Military blaster.lore: A military-grade piece, better balanced and kept clean. Quartermasters hand them out with a nod and a warning.

Elite blaster.lore: Elite work, tuned by someone who cared. Troopers who are issued one tend to take better care of it than of themselves.

none.lore: No armor at all. Quick, light, and a little reckless. The Jedi have always trusted the Force over plating.

light.lore: Flexible plates under a Republic jacket. It turns a glancing bolt and weighs almost nothing.

heavy.lore: Layered ceramic and alloy, built to take hits that would drop anyone else. It makes a trooper slow and very hard to move.

scope.lore: A narrow window on a far place. Scouts say the world looks calmer through glass, which is a lie worth believing.

barrel.lore: A longer barrel, a tighter bolt. Gunsmiths on Coruscant argue about the exact length, and nobody wins.

cell.lore: A power cell with a little more kick. It runs hot, and troopers learn to count their shots.

Training saber.lore: Padawans build their first blade under a Master’s eye. The training blade is simple, and it teaches by being forgiving.

Attuned saber.lore: Attuned to its owner. The crystal hums at a pitch only they can feel, and the blade answers their intent.

Master-forged saber.lore: Forged by a Master’s hand. It is not a weapon so much as a conversation between a Jedi and the Force.

focused.lore: A tightly bound beam that cuts where it is aimed and nowhere else. Some Jedi prefer clarity to power.

swift.lore: A lighter hilt and a quicker blade. It rewards those who prefer to finish a motion before the other side begins.

warden.lore: A blade made to protect. It turns away what it can, and the Jedi who carries it takes pride in what never gets through.

blue.lore: The blue crystal is the Guardian’s companion. It carries a calm, steady light and a reputation for defending first.

green.lore: The green blade is associated with the Consular, a Jedi of insight and negotiation. It is the color of patient hands.

yellow.lore: The yellow crystal is often chosen by Sentinels, who walk between study and duty. It burns bright, and it burns honestly.

violet.lore: A rare hue, said to come when a Jedi’s heart is torn two ways. Those who carry it speak little of why.

white.lore: A white blade is the mark of a crystal that was cleansed or purified. Jedi treat it as a quiet sign of a hard road walked.

shiiCho.lore: Form I, the Way of the Sarlacc. The first form: broad, forgiving, and the foundation on which every other Jedi is built.

makashi.lore: Form II, the Way of the Ysalamiri. The duelist’s Form: precise footwork, elegant strokes, built for facing another blade.

soresu.lore: Form III, the Way of the Mynock. Efficient and patient, it asks the Jedi to endure and to wait for the other side to tire.

ataru.lore: Form IV, the Way of the Hawk-Bat. Acrobatic and fast, it uses the Force to leap and strike, and tires its user quickly.

djemSo.lore: Form V, the Way of the Krayt Dragon. Also called Djem So, it blends strong defense with strong offense, and it prizes the deflected bolt returned.

niman.lore: Form VI, the Way of the Rancor. A moderate Form, balancing blade and Force, favored by those who see the Jedi as scholars first.

juyo.lore: Form VII, the Way of the Vornskr. Ferocious, almost too intense, it is taught with caution because of what it can do to a Jedi’s mind.

medium.lore: Plate that is neither light nor heavy, the quartermaster’s compromise. It lets a trooper run, kneel, and take a hit in the same afternoon.

robes.lore: Plain cloth worn by a thousand Jedi before. The weave is old, and it carries an odd comfort of its own.

armoredRobes.lore: A Jedi’s robes with plating hidden in the folds. The wearer looks like a pilgrim until the first bolt glances away.

stock.lore: A reworked grip and shoulder rest, made to steady a shot. It adds nothing flashy, only fewer misses.

trigger.lore: A lighter pull and a quicker break. The kind of change that makes a gunsmith smile and a rifleman nervous.

frag.lore: Compact, familiar, and exactly as loud as expected. Troopers carry them for the day when talking stops working.

medpac.lore: Bandage, stim, and sealant in a case the size of a hand. Every medic has watched it do more good than any speech.

boots.lore: Fitted with small servos that lengthen the stride. Scouts who wear them say the ground feels shorter.

visor.lore: A narrow lens that sharpens the distance and flags the faint shapes in it. It is a small thing, and it is why many troopers come home.

shield.lore: A belt-mounted emitter that throws up a thin film of energy. It blunts the worst and runs down quickly, so the wearer learns to stay alert.

medical.lore: Quiet beds and quiet voices. The Halls smell of bacta and clean linen, and everyone who passes through remembers them gently.

training.lore: The Salle echoes with practice blades and patient correction. Every Jedi has lost their first bout here and learned from it.

forge.lore: The crystal hums in the dark. Here a Jedi builds the blade they will carry, and learns something about themselves in the doing.

armory.lore: Racks of blasters and plates for the Republic soldiers who share the Temple’s halls. Not every defender carries a lightsaber.

comms.lore: Holos, relays, and a watch that never sleeps. In the Hub, news from the war arrives a little late and a little changed.

barracks.lore: Bunks, boots, and a card table nobody admits to owning. The troopers make a home out of whatever space they are given.

archives.lore: Millennia of memory, shelved and catalogued. The Archives hold the answer to many questions, and some questions the answer may not welcome.

gardens.lore: Moss, water, and a quiet that is carefully maintained. A good place to sit with a troubled thought until it loosens.

..lore: Open floor. Plain, scuffed, and honest. Most battles are decided on ground like this.

_.lore: A door left open. It invites movement, for friend and foe alike.

E.lore: The evacuation zone. A gunship waits, engines warm. Getting everyone to it is the whole point.

r.lore: Broken stone and twisted metal. Rubble slows the careless and shelters the careful.

c.lore: Stacked crates, supplies for someone’s better day. Good cover, and sometimes something useful inside.

h.lore: A wall torn open by force, leaving a ragged window. Sightlines appear where none were meant to.

x.lore: A drum of volatile fuel. Everyone nearby thinks about it at the same time.

k.lore: A control console, blinking patiently. Whoever sits at it learns what the building knows.

q.lore: A data terminal with unread files. Someone will want what it holds, and someone else will want it gone.

Q.lore: A terminal already copied. Its secrets now travel with the squad, and the building does not know.

b.lore: An alarm beacon, dark for now. If it lights, the room fills with more guests than were invited.

C.lore: A place for a charge. Whoever planted the last one here is long gone, and whoever plants this one should be too.

X.lore: A charge, armed and counting. No one stands near it on purpose.

#.lore: A solid wall. It keeps the dark outside and the light in, or the other way around.

B.lore: A reinforced blast wall, thick and sealed. Whoever built it expected a bad day.

O.lore: The objective. A relay, a shrine, a cave mouth. Something that matters more than the people who have come for it.

d.lore: A closed door. It opens to a hand, a will, or a well-aimed charge.

D.lore: A locked door, sealed against casual visitors. Locks are only questions, and some people are good at answers.

guard.lore: Standing at a friend’s shoulder, blade ready. Guarding is an act of faith in the one beside you.

overwatch.lore: Silent, still, and watching the door. Whoever steps through will be met.

down.lore: Fallen, but not gone. Someone is already moving to reach them.

stunned.lore: The world has gone soft and distant. A moment’s vulnerability is all the enemy needs.

surrender.lore: Hands up, weapon down. The Jedi accept the offer, because they were never here to kill anyone they did not have to.

captured.lore: Held, not harmed. A prisoner is a promise that someone will need to be answered later.

disarmed.lore: Empty hands in a fight that does not care. Resourcefulness fills in where equipment ends.

marked.lore: Singled out and called by name. Every weapon on the field now knows who to watch.

concealed.lore: Unseen, and counting on it. Stillness is a weapon too.

suppressed.lore: Pinned under steady fire. Raising a head is possible, but costly.

darkness.lore: The dark side whispers that the cost of a thing is a reason to do more of it. Jedi who listen find the voice grows louder.

panic.lore: Fear breaks free of its leash. Training says to breathe, and training is very far away.

highground.lore: The advantage of height. Seen from above, even an ugly battle makes a certain sense.

hunker.lore: Low behind cover, making the most of whatever stands between them and the next bolt. Not heroic, but very sensible.

barrier.lore: A wall of will in the air, thin and shimmering. Those behind it feel the Force holding the world back for a moment.

rooted.lore: Feet fixed to the ground by a will not their own. The world moves, and they do not.

shield.lore: A faint shimmer of energy over the skin. It drinks the first blows, and then it is gone.

stable.lore: The bleeding has slowed and the breath has steadied. They are still down, but they are no longer slipping away.

tricked.lore: A voice in the mind whispers a suggestion, and it sounds exactly like their own. The thought is not theirs, but they act on it.

stress0.lore: Breathing evenly, shoulders loose, mind clear. The squad notices the calm and draws on it.

stress1.lore: A tremor in the hands, a thin edge to the voice. It passes for most, and those who feel it are not weak for it.

stress2.lore: Past the point where willpower is enough. They need rest and quiet, and their friends need to let them have it.

oldWound.lore: The scar aches with the weather. It is a record of a hard day and a reminder of how it ended.

shakyHand.lore: A faint tremor that was not there before. The Jedi watch it, and the wearer learns to work around it.

badLeg.lore: A bad step that never quite healed. The limp is slight, and always noticed by the one who has it.

fearsHorrors.lore: Something in the dark found them once. They carry the memory into every cave afterward.

guilt.lore: They lived when others did not, and no one has convinced them it was acceptable. The weight is real, and so is the effort of carrying it.

nightmares.lore: Sleep brings back what the day forgot. They wake tired, and try again.

anger.lore: An old fury that fits in the hand like a stone. The Jedi who carries it feels stronger, and that is the warning.

Guardian.lore: The Guardian stands between harm and the people who cannot defend themselves. Strength, discipline, and a blade that serves protection first.

Consular.lore: The Consular seeks understanding before conflict. Diplomats, healers, and scholars of the Force, they would rather solve a problem than win it.

Sentinel.lore: The Sentinel walks between the two paths, balancing combat and insight. Cautious, adaptable, and never quite where the enemy expects.

Wayseeker.lore: A name from a much later age. In this era the term is unknown, and no Jedi here will answer to it.

Soldier.lore: The Republic’s trooper: disciplined, loyal, and trained to follow a plan through its worst hour.

Scout.lore: The scout goes ahead and returns with what the squad needs to know. Quiet, quick, and rarely thanked.

Medic.lore: The medic runs toward the wounded when everyone else runs away. A kit, a steady voice, and a lot of nerve.

Heavy.lore: The heavy carries what the others cannot. A big weapon, a big pack, and a stubbornness to match.

Defender.lore: Soresu masters who never strike first. They stand in the fire so others can walk out of it.

Shieldbearer.lore: Troopers in heavy plate behind a riot shield. Slow, loud, and the last thing a raider wants to charge.

VIP.lore: Someone whose survival matters more than their own preferences. They did not choose the role, and many of them handle it with grace.

coruscant.lore: The capital of the Republic, a world of endless towers and the Jedi Temple above the noise. For centuries it has felt untouchable.

alderaan.lore: A world of mountains and old noble houses. In this age it hosts the peace talks that the galaxy has been waiting for.

balmorra.lore: A world of foundries and weapon yards, fought over by both sides. Little of it has been left unscarred.

ordMantell.lore: A rough Mid Rim world of depots, smugglers, and Republic outposts. Easy to reach, hard to hold.

dantooine.lore: Open plains and quiet ruins, once home to a Jedi enclave. Rumor says the grassland hides things that hunt by night.

narShaddaa.lore: The Smuggler’s Moon, a glittering stack of neon and debt. Anything can be bought here, at a price someone else usually pays.

ossus.lore: A world of ruined Jedi archives, scoured by old wars. The shelves are empty in places, and the silence is not entirely empty.

ilum.lore: The ice world where Jedi come to find their kyber. The caves hum with something older than the Order.

taris.lore: A city world that has been burned and rebuilt more than once. The old towers still stand above the ruins of what they were.

tython.lore: The birthplace of the Jedi Order, far from the noise of the core. After the treaty, the Order turns toward it again.

korriban.lore: The tomb world of the ancient Sith. Dust and stone, and a presence that waits.

dromundKaas.lore: A jungle world of storms and predators, the seat of the Sith Empire. Its capital rises out of the rain like a threat.

hydianWay.lore: A hyperspace road that carries trade and troops alike. Whoever holds it holds the pulse of the Outer Rim.

ruusan.lore: A world scarred by a war that burned a thousand years later in memory. Its forests remember the cost of certainty.

zym.lore: Grand Master of the Order, tired and unyielding. He carries a Council’s worth of doubt, and does not let it show.

gnost.lore: A Kel Dor Jedi historian, breath-masked and unhurried. He believes that the past is the only teacher that cannot be bribed.

darach.lore: A Zabrak Jedi Master with a patient smile and a hard-earned scar. He teaches best by letting others make their own mistakes.

satele.lore: A young Knight with a famous name and an unfinished story. She carries the weight of a lineage she did not choose.

jace.lore: A Republic soldier who has seen too much and complained about it too little. His platoon would follow him anywhere sensible.

malgus.lore: A Sith Lord of terrible resolve, who struck at the heart of the Republic and meant it. His pain is not hidden, and neither is his power.

adraas.lore: A Sith Lord who commanded beside Malgus. He is cold, capable, and he regards the Temple as a trophy waiting to be taken.

eleena.lore: A Twi’lek who stands at Malgus’s side by choice. She sees more of him than anyone else does, and she is not afraid.

kira.lore: A Guardian Knight who leads from the front. She says little about the people she has lost, and carries every name.

tor.lore: A Consular Padawan with a mind quicker than his nerve. He is learning that courage is just fear that keeps walking.

dax.lore: A sergeant with twenty years of mud on his boots. He does not believe in luck, and keeps his squad alive anyway.

ilsa.lore: A scout who moves like a rumor. She prefers to be forgotten, and rarely is.

bren.lore: A medic with tired hands and a steady voice. He has lost patients, and has never stopped trying for the next one.

grak.lore: A heavy trooper built like a doorframe. Gentle in the barracks, immovable on the line.

saresh.lore: A Republic envoy with an easy manner and a careful vocabulary. Whatever he says, there seems to be something else behind it.

ondo.lore: A Senator with a loyal voice and a long list of enemies. He wants the treaty badly, and the Temple wants him alive to sign it.

corin.lore: An Imperial officer who changed sides at some personal cost. He is trusted a little less than he deserves, and a little more than he expects.

mira.lore: An aide who knows where every document is and who has read most of them. Quiet, observant, and indispensable.

thulHeir.lore: Lady Venna Thul, heir to an old Alderaanian house. She is young, careful, and aware that her name weighs more than she does.

relay.lore: A lonely relay on the frontier, keeping the lanes open for ships that never learn its name. The Sith want it silent, and they are coming in waves.

shrine.lore: Pilgrims have long come to a kyber shrine on Dantooine. Tonight something else has found it, and it has an appetite for the Force.

rescue.lore: A supply depot on Ord Mantell holds prisoners who matter to someone. The plan is simple, which means it will not go simply.

envoy.lore: Schedules leaked, secrets traded, and a trail that winds through the lower city. Someone near the talks is selling the Republic.

archive.lore: An Imperial listening post on Balmorra, tucked between foundries. What it hears could hurt the Republic, and what it holds could help.

sabotage.lore: An Imperial fuel depot on Balmorra, vast and poorly lit. A well-placed charge here could stall an advance for weeks.

escort.lore: A Senator must walk the length of Coruscant’s lower streets to reach the talks. The Temple walks with him.

blockade.lore: Mandalorians in Imperial pay have closed a stretch of the Hydian Way. A convoy is counting on the squad to open it.

cache.lore: A listening post on the Inner Rim has gone quiet. The squad is sent to find out why before anyone else does.

hutt.lore: A Hutt warehouse on Nar Shaddaa holds a ledger of debts and deals. In the right hands it could change the war.

dock.lore: Docking Ring Nine. Malgus is coming for the Temple, and the Jedi have one chance to stop him at the door.

vault.lore: Beneath the ruins of Ossus lie old records of the Sith wars. Gnost-Dural wants them saved, and the Empire wants them first.

ilum.lore: A cave mouth on Ilum, cold and humming. Sergeant Malcom’s platoon holds it, and the Jedi arrive in time to share the watch.

adraasHunt.lore: During the talks on Alderaan, Satele Shan leads a strike on Lord Adraas at an embassy hangar. It is a gamble with the treaty as the stake.

taris.lore: A reclamation camp on Taris, where captives were put to work. The Jedi come to open the gates, and to see who is still inside.

thul.lore: The heir to House Thul must cross Alderaan unseen. The Jedi go with her, because some journeys are not safe alone.

depot.lore: Forward Depot Cresh keeps the enemy fed and armed. Take away the depot and the front shifts.

fort.lore: Fort Garnik on Ord Mantell is old, battered, and still standing. The Republic means to keep it that way.

r_ravine.lore: The wounded of the Army of Light lie in a ravine as the Brotherhood closes in. Among them is Johun Othone, a young Knight in Lord Hoth’s service.

r_caves.lore: The caves of Ruusan run deep, and the Brotherhood is gathering in them. Some of what moves in the dark has no interest in soldiers at all.

r_bomb.lore: Kaan’s ritual would end the Light and the Dark together. Hoth goes to stop it, and the squad goes ahead of him.

r_hospital.lore: The Army of Light cares for its wounded far behind the line, and that is exactly where the Brotherhood strikes. The healers must be given time.

r_nexus.lore: Deep in the caves, the dark side has found a place to grow. It breeds only what hunts the gifted, so the troops go first.

r_snipers.lore: A courier carries the Army’s plans along a ridge trail, and the Brotherhood has paid for rifles to watch it. The road is short and the cover is thin.

r_dump.lore: The Brotherhood marches on powder and fuel. Take away the dump and the army slows, and that may be the difference.

ataru.lore: Acrobatics and the Force woven into every stroke. Padawans who study it often take a little too much joy in the leap.

djemSo.lore: Strike and counterstrike are the same motion seen from two sides. Masters teach it to those with the nerve to be struck first.

niman.lore: A balanced Form for Jedi who walk between the saber and the book. Many Masters have settled into it as the years grew long.

juyo.lore: The Form that burns too brightly. It is taught rarely, and always with one eye on the student’s heart.

fieldMed.lore: New protocols from the Temple’s healers, carried to the field in plain satchels. Another life saved is the only proof they ask for.

bacta.lore: Great tanks of the amber fluid, filled and tended. The Halls grow warmer, and the beds more often empty.

curriculum.lore: The Masters write down what they know and pass it on. The Salle grows stricter, and the Padawans grow stronger.

holocron.lore: Old holocrons, opened with care and heard patiently. Every mission leaves more to learn than before.

eliteMods.lore: A craftsman’s corner of the armory. Small changes, done well, quietly improve every shot.

visors.lore: Optics salvaged, refined, and issued to those who need to see farther. A small piece of glass that can change an afternoon.

shields.lore: Compact emitters brought up from the engineers. The troopers wear them with a mixture of gratitude and suspicion.

armorWeave.lore: A fiber woven with an old ore that resists the saber. The robes look the same and feel a little heavier.

kyberLore.lore: The old crafts, relearned and refined. Each crystal is a little less costly to bring to song.

codebreak.lore: Imperial ciphers broken one at a time by patient hands. A little more is known, and a little less is a surprise.

sithTactics.lore: Captured manuals read by the Temple’s tacticians. Knowing the enemy’s habits is the oldest advantage.

beastLore.lore: Reports from every survivor, collected and sorted. The monsters are less strange once they have been described.

logistics.lore: Rations, bunks, and rosters, made to run on time. No glamour in it, and nothing works without it.

SOURCE_LITERALS.raw: 'Patient hands, steady breath. A trooper learns that one clean shot saves more lives than ten loud ones.'
'The blade moves before the thought finishes. Every Padawan is taught that the strike is the last answer, not the first.'
'To stand between a blow and a friend is the oldest Jedi lesson. The Guardian does not ask who deserves it.'
'Waiting is a kind of fighting. The soldier who holds still and watches the door decides who walks through it.'
'A breath of the Force, shaped into a shove. It carries no malice, only a firm request to be elsewhere.'
'The Force gathers, then falls on one place at once. Masters warn that power taken this wide leaves a mark on the one who takes it.'
'The Council forbids it. A hand closes on a throat from across the room, and the one who holds it feels the dark answer back.'
'A pulse that quiets the body without breaking it. Mercy is a discipline, and it is harder than the alternative.'
'The Jedi prefer a prisoner who can talk to a corpse who cannot. Many a captive has surprised them with what they knew.'
'Stillness is not rest. The Jedi sits inside the storm and listens for what the Force is trying to say.'
'The Force knits what the blade has opened. It does not take away the fear, and the Jedi never claims that it does.'
'A small sphere, a short fuse, a loud decision. Troopers throw them at cover, and cover rarely argues.'
'A field medic’s first rule: keep them here. Everything else can be solved once the bleeding stops.'
'Every door in the Temple was built to open to a hand that is welcome. Out in the field, doors are less polite.'
'Old machines hold new secrets. A steady hand and a patient tech can still coax the truth out of them.'
'The Force reaches out and returns with shapes, heartbeats, and the cold spots where something is hiding.'
'Set the charge, count the steps, leave. Sabotage is quiet work done by people who would rather not be thanked.'
'A lightsaber thrown is a lightsaber risked. The Force brings it back, but the Jedi learns the length of a moment without it.'
'The blade turns the bolt. Another Jedi stands at the shoulder, and together they make a wall no blaster wants to test.'
'A Jedi’s jump is not strength but trust. The Force holds the air for the length of a heartbeat, and that is enough.'
'The Force shows the bolt before it leaves the barrel. The blade is only there to finish the thought.'
'One wide arc, and the room is a different place. The Guardian’s answer to being surrounded is to become the center.'
'The deeper art. A Consular gives of their own strength to restore another’s, and rests afterward without complaint.'
'A shell of will, thin as breath and hard as durasteel while it holds. Consulars say it is easier to build for others than for oneself.'
'Bacta, a steady voice, and a Force touch when the bacta runs short. The Temple’s healers learned to work under fire.'
'A suggestion, offered so gently that the listener believes it was their own idea. The Consulars say it is not a trick but a courtesy.'
'The Force can call back a life that has barely left. It asks a great deal, and the Jedi who answers is never quite the same.'
'Fire that does not seek to hit, only to keep heads down. A soldier’s way of buying others a few seconds of safe ground.'
'Get low, get small, let the world pass over. Surviving a bad moment is also a victory.'
'A spotter calls the target and everyone’s aim improves. Calm voices win more battles than brave ones.'
'A cloud to move behind. The enemy fires at where you were, and you are somewhere else.'
'Slicers say every lock is a conversation. Patience and a little cleverness will make most systems say yes.'
'Armor is a promise that a shot will not matter. The shredder round exists to break that promise.'
'All the weapon’s patience spent at once. The heavy trooper trades accuracy for the certainty that something will land.'
'One shot, taken after the long wait. A scout learns to hold their breath until the world holds still with them.'
'A word at the right moment. Veterans know that courage is mostly borrowed, passed hand to hand along the line.'
'A sharp sting and a gasp. Medics carry the stim for the worst day, and hope never to need it.'
'It is loud, and it is meant to be. The heavy trooper fires one when quiet has already failed.'
'The Form takes over. Cut follows cut so quickly that the opponent has no time to be afraid of the next one.'
'A Sentinel moves where eyes do not rest. They are there, and then they are behind you.'
'Some blows end a fight before it begins. Jedi who learn this also learn how heavy it is to use.'
'The Force whispers before the danger arrives. Sentinels trust that whisper and have been alive longer for it.'
'A flick of the wrist and the weapon is somewhere else. The Jedi way is to end the fight without ending the foe.'
'Where others see rubble, a scout sees a road. The best ones leave no tracks for anyone to follow.'
'Even a hungry thing can be soothed by a patient mind. It is slow work, and a gentle one.'
'The Force draws what you need into your hand, or an enemy into your reach. Take care, because it works both directions.'
'The ground itself remembers the Jedi’s step. A tremor rolls outward and knocks the unready off their feet.'
'Some Jedi feel the creatures of the wild more clearly than they feel people. The bond is quiet, and it is real.'
'A good soldier fires while moving, and a great one forgets the difference. Practice, bruises, and more practice.'
'A second pair of eyes behind the first. The shot is the shooter’s, but the war is won by the one who sees the whole field.'
'Gone before the alarm sounds. A scout who is never noticed is a scout whose reports always arrive.'
'Orders, drilled until they are habit. In the dark and the noise, protocol is what remains when thinking is too slow.'
'A small hovering disc that does one thing well. Soldiers name them anyway, and are not embarrassed to.'
'It does not harm flesh, only wires. Machines go quiet and the battle changes shape.'
'Not one step back. The line holds because each person on it decides, separately, that it will.'
'Layered plating, scuffed and patched. Every trooper has a story about the bolt it stopped.'
'Experience is a kind of armor. The veteran has seen this before, and the calm they carry spreads along the line.'
'Distance is only a matter of patience. The long barrel, the steady breath, the shot that nobody heard coming.'
'A trained eye finds the gap in the armor. It is not cruelty, only competence at a hard trade.'
'Cover, concealment, silence. The things that are not in the manual but have kept every old scout alive.'
'Bandages, a stim, and one clean cloth. Small things that matter most when everything else has gone wrong.'
'The medic fights because the line breaks without them. Carrying a rifle and a kit takes a particular kind of courage.'
'Heavy and worn, it never leaves the medic’s shoulder. What is inside has stopped more wounds than any speech.'
'Spare cells across the chest, clipped and counted. A soldier who runs dry is a soldier who is no longer useful to the people next to them.'
'The heavy trooper walks into the fire because the others cannot. Armor, mass, and the stubbornness to keep walking.'
'All the weight of the Form behind one stroke. Guardians are taught that restraint is what makes such a blow safe to swing.'
'Not the hardest cut but the truest. The blade goes exactly where the Force showed it would be needed.'
'The Force spreads outward like warmth through a cold room. Every hurt in reach eases, and the Consular asks nothing in return.'
'A ring of pressure rolls out from the Jedi’s hands. Nothing in its path is spared, and nothing in its path is meant to be killed.'
'The air thickens, then stops. Those caught in it find their limbs unwilling, and the Consular holds the pause with great effort.'
'The first shot is a question and the second is the answer. A good gunner learns to ask twice before the target can react.'
'A single bright signal and the wounded know where to crawl. The medic can give it only once, and gives it fully.'
'Years of drills in the Salle have taught the body to take a blow and keep standing. The Guardian counts bruises as lessons.'
'A Guardian who studies a rival’s feet more than their blade. The duel is often won before the first stroke.'
'On guard, the Jedi becomes a fixed point. Allies know exactly where the line is and trust that it will not move.'
'The first through every door. A Vanguard takes the risk so that those behind can measure it.'
'The Warden’s blade seems to be wherever the bolt is going. Those who watch it work call it luck, and the Warden calls it attention.'
'Some Guardians simply refuse to fall. It is not stubbornness, they say, but a promise made to everyone standing behind them.'
'The sum of a lifetime of patient practice. The blade is no longer a tool but a part of the hand.'
'A mind that has learned to be quiet. The Force flows more freely through a Jedi who is not arguing with themselves.'
'Fear is acknowledged, then set down. The Consular who has done this once finds it easier to do again.'
'A deep calm that seems to refill itself. Consulars say the Force is not spent so much as borrowed and returned.'
'The battle slows to those who have learned to read it. The Consular steps where the next moment will be, not where the last one was.'
'A Consular who has stopped fearing the Force and started listening to it. Such Jedi are rare, and rarely proud of it.'
'A Sentinel notices the loose stone, the shifted shadow, the breath held too long. Most of survival is simply noticing.'
'A Sentinel who has learned exactly where a fight turns. The finishing stroke is quick, and no one is allowed to enjoy it.'
'Footprints, scorch marks, the stillness of a room just emptied. The Tracker follows the story the enemy leaves behind.'
'The Sentinel who keeps watch through the dark hours. Nothing reaches the camp that has not first reached them.'
'A blade kept honest by daily care. The Sentinel treats sharpening as a kind of meditation.'
'The Sentinel crosses open ground as if the ground were reluctant to notice. Lessons in stealth are never entirely spoken.'
'Patient and unhurried, the Hunter lets the quarry make the first mistake. It always does.'
'The Forms are no longer steps to be remembered. The Sentinel lives inside them and the blade simply follows.'
'Bolts and blades pass through spaces the Jedi has already left. It looks like grace, and it is years of discipline.'
'Where the map ends, the Wayseeker keeps walking. A path appears for anyone who truly expects one.'
'The Force in living things, felt in the roots as clearly as in the stars. The Wayseeker draws on a deeper spring.'
'A body trained by long travel and little comfort. The Wayseeker endures what would send others home.'
'Someone who learned to move through wild places learned to move quietly. The skill carries over to every other kind of ground.'
'The creatures of the wild trust the Wayseeker, and the Wayseeker returns the trust. Neither side has ever been disappointed.'
'Distance is no barrier for those who listen. The Wayseeker sees the far ridge as clearly as the near.'
'Old instincts woken beneath careful training. The Wayseeker is a little frightening to watch, and knows it.'
'Hours at the range and nights cleaning the barrel. Good shooting is mostly habit and a little stubbornness.'
'A trooper who has been knocked down enough times to know how to get up. The lesson is physical, and also not.'
'The kind of shooter who is quiet at the range because the targets have said all there is to say.'
'Fear is a visitor, and the veteran does not offer it a chair. The line holds because the people on it are calm.'
'Orders, duty, and a stubborn refusal to be turned. Few things are as hard to move as a soldier who has decided.'
'A trooper whose voice carries and whose plans work. Others fall in without being asked, and are glad to.'
'Stories are told about this one in barracks across the Republic. The trooper rolls their eyes and keeps shooting.'
'A scout whose sight is a gift and a discipline. Distant things become plain, and plain things become useful.'
'Light on the feet and quick to the next cover. A scout lives in the spaces between where the enemy is looking.'
'One breath held, one shot let go. The Sniper is a rumor that sometimes becomes a fact.'
'Cold work for a necessary end. The scout who does it well rarely speaks of it afterward.'
'Others would have been left behind long ago. The Survivor has learned that coming home is a skill like any other.'
'The scout calls the range, the wind, and the target in one calm sentence. Every rifle nearby gets a little better.'
'Familiar with every gap in every armor design. The scout is not cruel, only precise.'
'A name whispered on the Rim and rarely seen on a report. The scout prefers it that way.'
'Across rubble and open street without a sound. By the time the enemy turns, the Phantom is elsewhere.'
'Field medicine learned by the book, then by the bruise. The drills make the hands steady when the voice is not.'
'Clean cuts and clean thinking on the worst night. A good surgeon is calm because someone else cannot be.'
'The medic has seen the worst a battlefield can offer. They keep working, and the squad draws strength from it.'
'Full kits, sorted by urgency, ready in the dark. The medic can find what they need by touch.'
'A medic who learned that sometimes the best treatment is keeping the enemy from firing. Few argue with the logic.'
'Soldiers on three worlds swear to have been saved by this one. The medic shrugs and moves on to the next.'
'Years in the field have taught this medic where to stand and when to run. Survivors remember the lessons gladly.'
'A heavy trooper with a respect for chemistry. Everything that explodes is eventually a tool.'
'Built to carry, built to endure. The heavy trooper does the work nobody else wants and does not complain.'
'A slow and steady wall of armor and nerve. Allies shelter behind it, and it does not flinch.'
'Heavy weapons need a steady hand and a patient eye. The gunner has both, which is rarer than it sounds.'
'Years of training with weapons that others cannot lift. The recoil is a conversation the gunner has learned to win.'
'A figure out of old stories, mountainous in plate. The trooper walks through fire and the enemy remembers it.'
'A heavy trooper who has stopped waiting for orders. On this ground, the Warlord is the order.'
'Sith Empire infantry, trained hard and ordered harder. Most of them believe in the Empire because they have never been offered another future.'
'A walking wall in Imperial plate, with a gun that wants to be heard. It is slow to turn and quick to punish those who stand still.'
'Imperial Intelligence does not announce itself. A cold hide, a long rifle, and a patience the Temple’s own scouts would respect.'
'A student of the Sith, hungry to be noticed by someone with more power. Lightning crackles in the fingers, and mercy has not yet been taught.'
'What is left when a great horror feeds. A Dark Husk has no mind of its own, only hunger, and it moves when its maker kills.'
'A beast bred, it is said, to hunt those who touch the Force. The Jedi who survive an encounter rarely describe it, but the nightmares do.'
'A Republic envoy with the right smile and the wrong friends. Whispers say that someone close to the talks is selling the schedule.'
'A Sith Lord who believes the Republic is a lie and means to prove it with fire. He fights like a man with nothing left to lose.'
'Mandalorian clans, hired by the Empire for the oldest reason there is. They fight with honor and are paid in credits.'
'Lord Adraas fought beside Malgus in the strike on Coruscant. Those who faced him remember how little he seemed to care about the cost.'
'Foot soldiers of the Brotherhood of Darkness, devoted to Lord Kaan’s vision. They fight as though the war were already won, and that certainty is their weapon.'
'A Dark Side warrior who fights for rage as much as for Kaan. The wounds only seem to feed it.'
'One of the Brotherhood’s Lords, who sees the Light as a delay to be removed. The troopers around it fight as if its approval were air.'
'A hired gun on the ridge who is paid to be patient. The Brotherhood buys loyalty with ideals and loyalty from this one with credits.'
'A creature born of the dark side in the Ruusan caves, hungry only for the Force. Soldiers without the gift pass it unnoticed, and it cannot forgive that.'
'A wound in the world where the dark side pools and festers. It does not move or speak, but it makes more of itself.'
'The heart of the cave, where the dark gathers. It beats slowly, and anyone who stays near it begins to hear it.'
'Lord Kaan, leader of the Brotherhood of Darkness, sure that the Sith should lead the galaxy. He is brilliant, ruthless, and wrong in a way he will never accept.'
'Darth Bane, a Sith apprentice who watches from the ridge and listens to the war with a stranger’s attention. He survives Ruusan, and what he builds from it will outlast everyone here.'
'Standard blaster'
'A standard-issue Republic blaster, worn smooth by many hands. It is not elegant, but it fires every time.'
'Military blaster'
'A military-grade piece, better balanced and kept clean. Quartermasters hand them out with a nod and a warning.'
'Elite blaster'
'Elite work, tuned by someone who cared. Troopers who are issued one tend to take better care of it than of themselves.'
'No armor at all. Quick, light, and a little reckless. The Jedi have always trusted the Force over plating.'
'Flexible plates under a Republic jacket. It turns a glancing bolt and weighs almost nothing.'
'Layered ceramic and alloy, built to take hits that would drop anyone else. It makes a trooper slow and very hard to move.'
'A narrow window on a far place. Scouts say the world looks calmer through glass, which is a lie worth believing.'
'A longer barrel, a tighter bolt. Gunsmiths on Coruscant argue about the exact length, and nobody wins.'
'A power cell with a little more kick. It runs hot, and troopers learn to count their shots.'
'Training saber'
'Padawans build their first blade under a Master’s eye. The training blade is simple, and it teaches by being forgiving.'
'Attuned saber'
'Attuned to its owner. The crystal hums at a pitch only they can feel, and the blade answers their intent.'
'Master-forged saber'
'Forged by a Master’s hand. It is not a weapon so much as a conversation between a Jedi and the Force.'
'A tightly bound beam that cuts where it is aimed and nowhere else. Some Jedi prefer clarity to power.'
'A lighter hilt and a quicker blade. It rewards those who prefer to finish a motion before the other side begins.'
'A blade made to protect. It turns away what it can, and the Jedi who carries it takes pride in what never gets through.'
'The blue crystal is the Guardian’s companion. It carries a calm, steady light and a reputation for defending first.'
'The green blade is associated with the Consular, a Jedi of insight and negotiation. It is the color of patient hands.'
'The yellow crystal is often chosen by Sentinels, who walk between study and duty. It burns bright, and it burns honestly.'
'A rare hue, said to come when a Jedi’s heart is torn two ways. Those who carry it speak little of why.'
'A white blade is the mark of a crystal that was cleansed or purified. Jedi treat it as a quiet sign of a hard road walked.'
'Form I, the Way of the Sarlacc. The first form: broad, forgiving, and the foundation on which every other Jedi is built.'
'Form II, the Way of the Ysalamiri. The duelist’s Form: precise footwork, elegant strokes, built for facing another blade.'
'Form III, the Way of the Mynock. Efficient and patient, it asks the Jedi to endure and to wait for the other side to tire.'
'Form IV, the Way of the Hawk-Bat. Acrobatic and fast, it uses the Force to leap and strike, and tires its user quickly.'
'Form V, the Way of the Krayt Dragon. Also called Djem So, it blends strong defense with strong offense, and it prizes the deflected bolt returned.'
'Form VI, the Way of the Rancor. A moderate Form, balancing blade and Force, favored by those who see the Jedi as scholars first.'
'Form VII, the Way of the Vornskr. Ferocious, almost too intense, it is taught with caution because of what it can do to a Jedi’s mind.'
'Plate that is neither light nor heavy, the quartermaster’s compromise. It lets a trooper run, kneel, and take a hit in the same afternoon.'
'Plain cloth worn by a thousand Jedi before. The weave is old, and it carries an odd comfort of its own.'
'A Jedi’s robes with plating hidden in the folds. The wearer looks like a pilgrim until the first bolt glances away.'
'A reworked grip and shoulder rest, made to steady a shot. It adds nothing flashy, only fewer misses.'
'A lighter pull and a quicker break. The kind of change that makes a gunsmith smile and a rifleman nervous.'
'Compact, familiar, and exactly as loud as expected. Troopers carry them for the day when talking stops working.'
'Bandage, stim, and sealant in a case the size of a hand. Every medic has watched it do more good than any speech.'
'Fitted with small servos that lengthen the stride. Scouts who wear them say the ground feels shorter.'
'A narrow lens that sharpens the distance and flags the faint shapes in it. It is a small thing, and it is why many troopers come home.'
'A belt-mounted emitter that throws up a thin film of energy. It blunts the worst and runs down quickly, so the wearer learns to stay alert.'
'Quiet beds and quiet voices. The Halls smell of bacta and clean linen, and everyone who passes through remembers them gently.'
'The Salle echoes with practice blades and patient correction. Every Jedi has lost their first bout here and learned from it.'
'The crystal hums in the dark. Here a Jedi builds the blade they will carry, and learns something about themselves in the doing.'
'Racks of blasters and plates for the Republic soldiers who share the Temple’s halls. Not every defender carries a lightsaber.'
'Holos, relays, and a watch that never sleeps. In the Hub, news from the war arrives a little late and a little changed.'
'Bunks, boots, and a card table nobody admits to owning. The troopers make a home out of whatever space they are given.'
'Millennia of memory, shelved and catalogued. The Archives hold the answer to many questions, and some questions the answer may not welcome.'
'Moss, water, and a quiet that is carefully maintained. A good place to sit with a troubled thought until it loosens.'
'Open floor. Plain, scuffed, and honest. Most battles are decided on ground like this.'
'A door left open. It invites movement, for friend and foe alike.'
'The evacuation zone. A gunship waits, engines warm. Getting everyone to it is the whole point.'
'Broken stone and twisted metal. Rubble slows the careless and shelters the careful.'
'Stacked crates, supplies for someone’s better day. Good cover, and sometimes something useful inside.'
'A wall torn open by force, leaving a ragged window. Sightlines appear where none were meant to.'
'A drum of volatile fuel. Everyone nearby thinks about it at the same time.'
'A control console, blinking patiently. Whoever sits at it learns what the building knows.'
'A data terminal with unread files. Someone will want what it holds, and someone else will want it gone.'
'A terminal already copied. Its secrets now travel with the squad, and the building does not know.'
'An alarm beacon, dark for now. If it lights, the room fills with more guests than were invited.'
'A place for a charge. Whoever planted the last one here is long gone, and whoever plants this one should be too.'
'A charge, armed and counting. No one stands near it on purpose.'
'A solid wall. It keeps the dark outside and the light in, or the other way around.'
'A reinforced blast wall, thick and sealed. Whoever built it expected a bad day.'
'The objective. A relay, a shrine, a cave mouth. Something that matters more than the people who have come for it.'
'A closed door. It opens to a hand, a will, or a well-aimed charge.'
'A locked door, sealed against casual visitors. Locks are only questions, and some people are good at answers.'
'Standing at a friend’s shoulder, blade ready. Guarding is an act of faith in the one beside you.'
'Silent, still, and watching the door. Whoever steps through will be met.'
'Fallen, but not gone. Someone is already moving to reach them.'
'The world has gone soft and distant. A moment’s vulnerability is all the enemy needs.'
'Hands up, weapon down. The Jedi accept the offer, because they were never here to kill anyone they did not have to.'
'Held, not harmed. A prisoner is a promise that someone will need to be answered later.'
'Empty hands in a fight that does not care. Resourcefulness fills in where equipment ends.'
'Singled out and called by name. Every weapon on the field now knows who to watch.'
'Unseen, and counting on it. Stillness is a weapon too.'
'Pinned under steady fire. Raising a head is possible, but costly.'
'The dark side whispers that the cost of a thing is a reason to do more of it. Jedi who listen find the voice grows louder.'
'Fear breaks free of its leash. Training says to breathe, and training is very far away.'
'The advantage of height. Seen from above, even an ugly battle makes a certain sense.'
'Low behind cover, making the most of whatever stands between them and the next bolt. Not heroic, but very sensible.'
'A wall of will in the air, thin and shimmering. Those behind it feel the Force holding the world back for a moment.'
'Feet fixed to the ground by a will not their own. The world moves, and they do not.'
'A faint shimmer of energy over the skin. It drinks the first blows, and then it is gone.'
'The bleeding has slowed and the breath has steadied. They are still down, but they are no longer slipping away.'
'A voice in the mind whispers a suggestion, and it sounds exactly like their own. The thought is not theirs, but they act on it.'
'Breathing evenly, shoulders loose, mind clear. The squad notices the calm and draws on it.'
'A tremor in the hands, a thin edge to the voice. It passes for most, and those who feel it are not weak for it.'
'Past the point where willpower is enough. They need rest and quiet, and their friends need to let them have it.'
'The scar aches with the weather. It is a record of a hard day and a reminder of how it ended.'
'A faint tremor that was not there before. The Jedi watch it, and the wearer learns to work around it.'
'A bad step that never quite healed. The limp is slight, and always noticed by the one who has it.'
'Something in the dark found them once. They carry the memory into every cave afterward.'
'They lived when others did not, and no one has convinced them it was acceptable. The weight is real, and so is the effort of carrying it.'
'Sleep brings back what the day forgot. They wake tired, and try again.'
'An old fury that fits in the hand like a stone. The Jedi who carries it feels stronger, and that is the warning.'
'The Guardian stands between harm and the people who cannot defend themselves. Strength, discipline, and a blade that serves protection first.'
'The Consular seeks understanding before conflict. Diplomats, healers, and scholars of the Force, they would rather solve a problem than win it.'
'The Sentinel walks between the two paths, balancing combat and insight. Cautious, adaptable, and never quite where the enemy expects.'
'A name from a much later age. In this era the term is unknown, and no Jedi here will answer to it.'
'The Republic’s trooper: disciplined, loyal, and trained to follow a plan through its worst hour.'
'The scout goes ahead and returns with what the squad needs to know. Quiet, quick, and rarely thanked.'
'The medic runs toward the wounded when everyone else runs away. A kit, a steady voice, and a lot of nerve.'
'The heavy carries what the others cannot. A big weapon, a big pack, and a stubbornness to match.'
'Soresu masters who never strike first. They stand in the fire so others can walk out of it.'
'Troopers in heavy plate behind a riot shield. Slow, loud, and the last thing a raider wants to charge.'
'Someone whose survival matters more than their own preferences. They did not choose the role, and many of them handle it with grace.'
'The capital of the Republic, a world of endless towers and the Jedi Temple above the noise. For centuries it has felt untouchable.'
'A world of mountains and old noble houses. In this age it hosts the peace talks that the galaxy has been waiting for.'
'A world of foundries and weapon yards, fought over by both sides. Little of it has been left unscarred.'
'A rough Mid Rim world of depots, smugglers, and Republic outposts. Easy to reach, hard to hold.'
'Open plains and quiet ruins, once home to a Jedi enclave. Rumor says the grassland hides things that hunt by night.'
'The Smuggler’s Moon, a glittering stack of neon and debt. Anything can be bought here, at a price someone else usually pays.'
'A world of ruined Jedi archives, scoured by old wars. The shelves are empty in places, and the silence is not entirely empty.'
'The ice world where Jedi come to find their kyber. The caves hum with something older than the Order.'
'A city world that has been burned and rebuilt more than once. The old towers still stand above the ruins of what they were.'
'The birthplace of the Jedi Order, far from the noise of the core. After the treaty, the Order turns toward it again.'
'The tomb world of the ancient Sith. Dust and stone, and a presence that waits.'
'A jungle world of storms and predators, the seat of the Sith Empire. Its capital rises out of the rain like a threat.'
'A hyperspace road that carries trade and troops alike. Whoever holds it holds the pulse of the Outer Rim.'
'A world scarred by a war that burned a thousand years later in memory. Its forests remember the cost of certainty.'
'Grand Master of the Order, tired and unyielding. He carries a Council’s worth of doubt, and does not let it show.'
'A Kel Dor Jedi historian, breath-masked and unhurried. He believes that the past is the only teacher that cannot be bribed.'
'A Zabrak Jedi Master with a patient smile and a hard-earned scar. He teaches best by letting others make their own mistakes.'
'A young Knight with a famous name and an unfinished story. She carries the weight of a lineage she did not choose.'
'A Republic soldier who has seen too much and complained about it too little. His platoon would follow him anywhere sensible.'
'A Sith Lord of terrible resolve, who struck at the heart of the Republic and meant it. His pain is not hidden, and neither is his power.'
'A Sith Lord who commanded beside Malgus. He is cold, capable, and he regards the Temple as a trophy waiting to be taken.'
'A Twi’lek who stands at Malgus’s side by choice. She sees more of him than anyone else does, and she is not afraid.'
'A Guardian Knight who leads from the front. She says little about the people she has lost, and carries every name.'
'A Consular Padawan with a mind quicker than his nerve. He is learning that courage is just fear that keeps walking.'
'A sergeant with twenty years of mud on his boots. He does not believe in luck, and keeps his squad alive anyway.'
'A scout who moves like a rumor. She prefers to be forgotten, and rarely is.'
'A medic with tired hands and a steady voice. He has lost patients, and has never stopped trying for the next one.'
'A heavy trooper built like a doorframe. Gentle in the barracks, immovable on the line.'
'A Republic envoy with an easy manner and a careful vocabulary. Whatever he says, there seems to be something else behind it.'
'A Senator with a loyal voice and a long list of enemies. He wants the treaty badly, and the Temple wants him alive to sign it.'
'An Imperial officer who changed sides at some personal cost. He is trusted a little less than he deserves, and a little more than he expects.'
'An aide who knows where every document is and who has read most of them. Quiet, observant, and indispensable.'
'Lady Venna Thul, heir to an old Alderaanian house. She is young, careful, and aware that her name weighs more than she does.'
'A lonely relay on the frontier, keeping the lanes open for ships that never learn its name. The Sith want it silent, and they are coming in waves.'
'Pilgrims have long come to a kyber shrine on Dantooine. Tonight something else has found it, and it has an appetite for the Force.'
'A supply depot on Ord Mantell holds prisoners who matter to someone. The plan is simple, which means it will not go simply.'
'Schedules leaked, secrets traded, and a trail that winds through the lower city. Someone near the talks is selling the Republic.'
'An Imperial listening post on Balmorra, tucked between foundries. What it hears could hurt the Republic, and what it holds could help.'
'An Imperial fuel depot on Balmorra, vast and poorly lit. A well-placed charge here could stall an advance for weeks.'
'A Senator must walk the length of Coruscant’s lower streets to reach the talks. The Temple walks with him.'
'Mandalorians in Imperial pay have closed a stretch of the Hydian Way. A convoy is counting on the squad to open it.'
'A listening post on the Inner Rim has gone quiet. The squad is sent to find out why before anyone else does.'
'A Hutt warehouse on Nar Shaddaa holds a ledger of debts and deals. In the right hands it could change the war.'
'Docking Ring Nine. Malgus is coming for the Temple, and the Jedi have one chance to stop him at the door.'
'Beneath the ruins of Ossus lie old records of the Sith wars. Gnost-Dural wants them saved, and the Empire wants them first.'
'A cave mouth on Ilum, cold and humming. Sergeant Malcom’s platoon holds it, and the Jedi arrive in time to share the watch.'
'During the talks on Alderaan, Satele Shan leads a strike on Lord Adraas at an embassy hangar. It is a gamble with the treaty as the stake.'
'A reclamation camp on Taris, where captives were put to work. The Jedi come to open the gates, and to see who is still inside.'
'The heir to House Thul must cross Alderaan unseen. The Jedi go with her, because some journeys are not safe alone.'
'Forward Depot Cresh keeps the enemy fed and armed. Take away the depot and the front shifts.'
'Fort Garnik on Ord Mantell is old, battered, and still standing. The Republic means to keep it that way.'
'The wounded of the Army of Light lie in a ravine as the Brotherhood closes in. Among them is Johun Othone, a young Knight in Lord Hoth’s service.'
'The caves of Ruusan run deep, and the Brotherhood is gathering in them. Some of what moves in the dark has no interest in soldiers at all.'
'Kaan’s ritual would end the Light and the Dark together. Hoth goes to stop it, and the squad goes ahead of him.'
'The Army of Light cares for its wounded far behind the line, and that is exactly where the Brotherhood strikes. The healers must be given time.'
'Deep in the caves, the dark side has found a place to grow. It breeds only what hunts the gifted, so the troops go first.'
'A courier carries the Army’s plans along a ridge trail, and the Brotherhood has paid for rifles to watch it. The road is short and the cover is thin.'
'The Brotherhood marches on powder and fuel. Take away the dump and the army slows, and that may be the difference.'
'Acrobatics and the Force woven into every stroke. Padawans who study it often take a little too much joy in the leap.'
'Strike and counterstrike are the same motion seen from two sides. Masters teach it to those with the nerve to be struck first.'
'A balanced Form for Jedi who walk between the saber and the book. Many Masters have settled into it as the years grew long.'
'The Form that burns too brightly. It is taught rarely, and always with one eye on the student’s heart.'
'New protocols from the Temple’s healers, carried to the field in plain satchels. Another life saved is the only proof they ask for.'
'Great tanks of the amber fluid, filled and tended. The Halls grow warmer, and the beds more often empty.'
'The Masters write down what they know and pass it on. The Salle grows stricter, and the Padawans grow stronger.'
'Old holocrons, opened with care and heard patiently. Every mission leaves more to learn than before.'
'A craftsman’s corner of the armory. Small changes, done well, quietly improve every shot.'
'Optics salvaged, refined, and issued to those who need to see farther. A small piece of glass that can change an afternoon.'
'Compact emitters brought up from the engineers. The troopers wear them with a mixture of gratitude and suspicion.'
'A fiber woven with an old ore that resists the saber. The robes look the same and feel a little heavier.'
'The old crafts, relearned and refined. Each crystal is a little less costly to bring to song.'
'Imperial ciphers broken one at a time by patient hands. A little more is known, and a little less is a surprise.'
'Captured manuals read by the Temple’s tacticians. Knowing the enemy’s habits is the oldest advantage.'
'Reports from every survivor, collected and sorted. The monsters are less strange once they have been described.'
'Rations, bunks, and rosters, made to run on time. No glamour in it, and nothing works without it.'

text:
/* Codex lore (flavor) for every id. U’s describe(kind,id) shows CODEX[kind][id].lore next to the owner’s mechanical desc. ≤280 chars each. Voice: docs/specs/story.md §9.
   Confidence tags in comments: [C]=Disney canon, [L]=Legends, [N]=invented for this game; H/M/L = confidence. */
const CODEX={
 ability:{
  shoot:{lore:'Patient hands, steady breath. A trooper learns that one clean shot saves more lives than ten loud ones.'}, // [N]
  strike:{lore:'The blade moves before the thought finishes. Every Padawan is taught that the strike is the last answer, not the first.'}, // [N]
  guard:{lore:'To stand between a blow and a friend is the oldest Jedi lesson. The Guardian does not ask who deserves it.'}, // [L H] Guardian ideal; [N] phrasing
  overwatch:{lore:'Waiting is a kind of fighting. The soldier who holds still and watches the door decides who walks through it.'}, // [N]
  push:{lore:'A breath of the Force, shaped into a shove. It carries no malice, only a firm request to be elsewhere.'}, // [N]
  collapse:{lore:'The Force gathers, then falls on one place at once. Masters warn that power taken this wide leaves a mark on the one who takes it.'}, // [N]
  choke:{lore:'The Council forbids it. A hand closes on a throat from across the room, and the one who holds it feels the dark answer back.'}, // [N]
